subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 7/7] Add MAINTAINERS file and get_maintainer.pl

reviews.author: Benjamin Coddington
reviews.summary:
Reviewer noted that the default value of output_Roles should be off to prevent b4 prep --auto-to-cc from adding 'open list:NFS-UTILS' onto the email display name.

Reviewer noted that get_maintainer.pl finds the top of the current git tree instead of its own location, and suggested using the script's location to resolve this issue.
reviews.raw_body:
^^ output_Roles should default to off because otherwise using this with
b4 mangles adds that "open list:NFS-UTILS" onto the list's email display
name:

b4 prep --auto-to-cc
Collecting To/Cc addresses
    + To: Steve Dickson <steved@redhat.com>
    + Cc: open list:NFS-UTILS <linux-nfs@vger.kernel.org>

---

This finds the top of whatever git tree the cwd is in, not the tree
the script lives in.  Running it from a kernel tree:

  $ cd linux
  $ ~/nfs-utils/scripts/get_maintainer.pl -f fs/nfsd/export.c

reads the kernel's MAINTAINERS and prints the knfsd maintainers.

The fallback also leaves "scripts/.." in $topdir, so the -f prefix
strip never matches an absolute path when run from a tarball.

Maybe just always use the script's location:

        return abs_path(dirname(abs_path($0)) . '/..');

b4 runs it from the tree top, so that wouldn't change anything there.

Ben

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a kernel-style MAINTAINERS file and a get_maintainer.pl script to the nfs-utils package. The MAINTAINERS file provides information on how to submit changes, including the mailing list and required Signed-off-by trailer. The get_maintainer.pl script implements match types F/X/N/K and is used by scripts like b4 prep --auto-to-cc to collect To/Cc addresses for patches. The patch also includes new tests and updates Makefile.am and other files.
